subject: math
description: Define sectors of a circle and calculate sector area using central-angle fraction reasoning.
learningObjectives: Define a sector as the region bounded by two radii and the included arc
Recognize the central angle that determines a sector's fraction of the circle
Calculate sector area using the fraction theta over 360
Connect common central angles to familiar fractions of a circle
Explain why sector area is a fraction of the full circle area
prerequisites: Recognizing the center, radius, and arc of a circle
Understanding that a full circle measures 360 degrees
Finding the area of a circle using A = pi r^2
Simplifying basic fractions such as 90/360 and 120/360
